# Animation reference · V98

Complete human/AI reference. Source links refer to files in the editable project. Factory values and live instance exports are distinct.

# Editable animation contract for humans and AI

## Use an existing animation

Open **Animation library**, search everyday words such as “cloud”, “eye”, “wall”, “fire”, “shoe” or “3D”, then choose **Add & preview**. The editor inserts an independent layer in the blank composition. Choose a source asset, replace named source slots, and scrub the preview. Native-only entries open the existing editor tools instead.

Every composition layer has start time, duration, opacity, start/end position, scale, rotation, tilt, blur and blending. **Playback** exposes speed, reversal, delay, one pause, easing and optional slow/fast timing. **Independent source bindings** replace content for one layer. **Effect parameters** exposes exact native scalar values; advanced JSON edits nested masks, routes, object lists and keyframes. The generic cloud pass and wall passage support `up`, `down`, `left`, `right` without rotating or mirroring artwork. Timing reversal is available for other rendered layers; arbitrary geometric direction changes depend on the renderer.

**Save animation preset** saves movement, native parameters, duration and transforms. Loading a preset for the same effect preserves selected sources. **Export composition JSON** captures actual current layers, content bindings and creative context. Uploaded media must travel separately; JSON does not embed its bytes. Existing template scenes keep their original native editor controls; use the library to create independently timed reusable instances.

## Authoritative files

| File | Meaning | Audience |
|---|---|---|
| `scripts/animation-catalog-spec.json` | Stable IDs, descriptions, aliases, adapters, source slots and limitations | Maintainers and generator |
| `scripts/animation-source-map.json` | Explicit role of each top-level implementation module | Coverage check |
| `dist/animation-registry.json` | Generated exact factory defaults, type/unit evidence, source hashes, functions and fallback expressions | Editor and future AI |
| `dist/animation-instance.schema.json` | Machine-readable instance envelope and shared playback types | Future AI and validators |
| `docs/ANIMATION-CATALOG.md` | Generated index | Humans and AI |
| `docs/animations/*.md` | Per-effect implementation descriptions, values and JSON recipes | Humans and AI |
| Composition JSON | Actual instance settings, timing, sources, transforms and context | Renderer and future AI |

Factory defaults are not the current browser-local settings. Renderer fallback expressions appear under `sourceInventory[].nativeFallbacks`; they are evidence, not necessarily active defaults. Values with unresolved units are explicitly labelled native and link to their implementation. Preserve exact numbers: `1.5` remains `1.5`. Do not round `1.6849999999999996` without a deliberate migration. Shared playback `speed` is a multiplier; a native speed field may mean pixels per second, radians per second or another rate.

## Instance example

```json
{
  "schema": "regaarder-animation-instance-v1",
  "effectId": "spatial-occlusion-pass",
  "parameters": {
    "historyPassageDirection": "left",
    "historyPassageStart": 0,
    "historyPassageEnd": 4
  },
  "playback": {
    "speed": 1.5,
    "reverse": false,
    "delay": 0,
    "pauseAt": 0.5,
    "pauseFor": 0,
    "ease": "linear",
    "slowFast": false,
    "slowStart": 0.3,
    "slowEnd": 0.65,
    "slowSpeed": 0.35,
    "fastSpeed": 2
  },
  "bindings": {
    "historyShoulder": "source-asset-id",
    "historyPortrait": "destination-asset-id"
  }
}
```

Resolve sparse parameters over the definition defaults. A blank layer stores resolved parameters and additionally has `start`, `duration`, `assetId` and transform endpoints. Presets omit content bindings. `createAnimationInstance` deep-copies definitions; never mutate registry objects when editing a layer.

The shared source clock maps `(elapsed − delay) × speed`, freezes at `pauseAt` for `pauseFor` real seconds, then continues. Easing and a positive continuous slow/fast warp remap normalized progress. Reversal runs the result backward. The visible layer span is `duration / speed + delay + pauseFor`; composition duration extends to contain it. Slow/fast reshapes time inside this span. Native scene curves still apply; linear shared time does not erase intrinsic renderer easing.

The generic focus action takes replaceable starting/destination pictures and normalizes its camera to the chosen duration. Edit focus coordinates and mask to use an eye, body part or object. The historical scene retains the original layered character camera. The generic cloud action uses one continuous travel distance. The wall action moves opaque planes behind a textured foreground wall without a crossfade.

## Registration contract

`MotionCore.registerCapability(id, definition)` is the live insertion point. All blank layers, including future registered actions, receive shared timing and transforms. A capability may declare serializable `defaults`, `slots`, `render(ctx, sourceSeconds, layer)` and `edit(host, layer, save)`. Catalog adapters call existing renderers. Slot replacements are scoped to the layer's render and restored afterward. Duplicates deep-copy their settings.

Images on the 3D image action remain planes. Primitive geometry supports its listed shapes. One image does not reconstruct unseen solid geometry. Original artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration; arbitrary automatic retargeting and AI-generated movement are not implemented. Named scene slots currently accept images, as required by the native scene renderers; the main media layer supports image/video. Not every legacy action has a universal insertion adapter. These entries are labelled **native tools**. No AI service is connected by this release.

## Mandatory rules for future animations

1. Assign a stable descriptive effect ID. Reuse an existing renderer for another instance rather than copying its code.
2. Describe visible behavior and implementation; add everyday search aliases, replaceable slots, supported media and limitations.
3. Declare exact defaults, type, unit and meaningful range/step when known. Keep uncertain units explicitly native. Nested data must remain serializable and editable.
4. Register independent instances through `MotionCore`, preserving shared timing. Expose simple controls, advanced controls, replacement and motion-only presets. Label native-only historical records honestly.
5. Classify every new module in the source map; link effects to implementation modules and default scopes. Document migrations separately from defaults.
6. Run `node scripts/build-animation-registry.mjs`. Never edit generated Markdown/JSON manually. Run the same command with `--check` to reject stale output. Unknown new top-level modules and uncovered animation modules fail the build.
7. Add meaningful tests for timing, replacement isolation and special geometry, with runtime preview access. Follow the existing visual-fidelity approval policy for substantial visual work.
8. Update asset provenance for changed procedural renderers/distributed assets. Keep all prior asset candidates and run relevant regression checks.

## Validation limits

Automated checks cover registry/default/hash parity, timing spans, positive continuous time warp, four-direction opaque wall coverage and catalog UI search/insertion/preset behavior in a DOM harness. Existing scene tests remain. Native-browser appearance, interaction ergonomics and video/3D behavior still require visual review. Automated checks do not prove exact perceptual equivalence to the reference footage.


## V65 layer-first policy
When reference depth is uncertain, use independently replaceable image layers by default. Keep source identity separate from motion. Do not claim recovered 3D. New chapter controls expose replacement, position, size and visibility first, with advanced depth/rotation/material/timing collapsed. All actions use the shared MotionCore playback wrapper for speed, reversal and slow/fast clocks. Preserve prior artwork and generated candidates.


# Animation catalog · V98

Human and AI share stable effect IDs, exact factory defaults and implementation evidence. Live settings are separate composition exports. Read ANIMATION-ARCHITECTURE.md for the editing contract and future-animation requirements.

## Shared playback defaults

```json
{
  "speed": 1,
  "reverse": false,
  "delay": 0,
  "pauseAt": 0.5,
  "pauseFor": 0,
  "ease": "linear",
  "slowFast": false,
  "slowStart": 0.3,
  "slowEnd": 0.65,
  "slowSpeed": 0.35,
  "fastSpeed": 2
}
```

Shared speed `1.5` means 1.5×. Native rate fields retain their own renderer units.

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## depot-cargo

### Layered cargo and markings

Stable ID: `depot-cargo`

Separate editable cargo planes with position, depth and insignia.

#### Implementation

- [depot.js](../../dist/depot.js) — SHA-256 `efb647ed9696bfa9a735b9c66e56e4e18c849720a8a5b69a8a63cec588a2f6d9`; functions: `repaintDepotAssets` (line 8), `updateDepotAssetStatus` (line 9), `reloadDepotAssets` (line 10), `paintDepotSmoke` (line 15), `renderDepot` (line 16), `seekDepot` (line 29), `depotObjectFields` (line 33), `depotMarkFields` (line 34), `renderDepotControls` (line 35).
- [depot-scene.js](../../dist/depot-scene.js) — SHA-256 `84ce38ca005a616ea88b489c5353373fe40eee1fe8949e357cf7d13c2823d211`; functions: `drawDepotInsignia` (line 7), `createDepotScene` (line 8), `cover` (line 8).
- [depot-assets.js](../../dist/depot-assets.js) — SHA-256 `d1fae065e976135f37854b26afd31c510392dd6a14d3991f245c67d566943505`; functions: `depotAssetState` (line 3), `attachDepotAsset` (line 4), `depotFigureTexture` (line 6).

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## depot-people

### Two depot figures

Stable ID: `depot-people`

Separate figure layers and editable armband markings.

#### Implementation

- [depot.js](../../dist/depot.js) — SHA-256 `efb647ed9696bfa9a735b9c66e56e4e18c849720a8a5b69a8a63cec588a2f6d9`; functions: `repaintDepotAssets` (line 8), `updateDepotAssetStatus` (line 9), `reloadDepotAssets` (line 10), `paintDepotSmoke` (line 15), `renderDepot` (line 16), `seekDepot` (line 29), `depotObjectFields` (line 33), `depotMarkFields` (line 34), `renderDepotControls` (line 35).
- [depot-scene.js](../../dist/depot-scene.js) — SHA-256 `84ce38ca005a616ea88b489c5353373fe40eee1fe8949e357cf7d13c2823d211`; functions: `drawDepotInsignia` (line 7), `createDepotScene` (line 8), `cover` (line 8).
- [depot-assets.js](../../dist/depot-assets.js) — SHA-256 `d1fae065e976135f37854b26afd31c510392dd6a14d3991f245c67d566943505`; functions: `depotAssetState` (line 3), `attachDepotAsset` (line 4), `depotFigureTexture` (line 6).

    "direction": "Timing reversal; geometric axes only where implemented",

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## chapter-shoes

### Chapter title and floating shoes

Stable ID: `chapter-shoes`

Text assembles while independently transformed procedural shoes float and turn.

#### Implementation

- [chapter-motion.js](../../dist/chapter-motion.js) — SHA-256 `3eef1420ebb8f5d13d0412de717ef0174da6e38b2593b2a7c64d0c7f615404ca`; functions: `chapterState` (line 4), `shardFall` (line 5), `chapterFocus` (line 7).
- [chapter-shoes.js](../../dist/chapter-shoes.js) — SHA-256 `e7986fc125d900985a4eb46f32d2523a04a9a17c85a9f1172e9b5cccd353b010`; functions: `shoePose` (line 5), `rotatePoint` (line 6), `rgb` (line 7), `last` (line 11), `upperPoint` (line 12), `shoeMesh` (line 13), `paintShoe` (line 65).
- [depot-chapter.js](../../dist/depot-chapter.js) — SHA-256 `832b13b002ff1b53f5e0cc4202da4586ad7558838697be629834a76be4a67323`; functions: `glow` (line 8), `paintLogoExit` (line 9), `paintChapter` (line 10).
- [chapter-director.js](../../dist/chapter-director.js) — SHA-256 `5a5f9392d12c2746c4630f17c2deec0c1bbe3d5ebf8ef630a5f636b7851041bf`; functions: `render` (line 25).

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## reference-continuation

### Reference continuation · paper through shoe diagram

Stable ID: `reference-continuation`

Reference continuation · paper through shoe diagram. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; full original geometry is unknown.
- Changing phase times stretches associated events. Custom shot-duration ratios are preserved.
- Photographic leg poses are layered animation, not full motion-captured gait.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## paper-tumble-unfurl

### Paper tumble with concurrent unfurl

Stable ID: `paper-tumble-unfurl`

Paper tumble with concurrent unfurl. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## room-picture-overlap

### Woman to boy · aligned room overlap

Stable ID: `room-picture-overlap`

Woman to boy · aligned room overlap. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## ruined-street-approach

### Ruined street · red sky and depth approach

Stable ID: `ruined-street-approach`

Ruined street · red sky and depth approach. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## salvage-walk-searchlight

### Salvage walk · searchlight and materials

Stable ID: `salvage-walk-searchlight`

Salvage walk · searchlight and materials. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## material-focus-highlight

### Material focus · cables and highlights

Stable ID: `material-focus-highlight`

Material focus · cables and highlights. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## vertical-bicycle-passage

### Vertical passage into bicycle scene

Stable ID: `vertical-bicycle-passage`

Vertical passage into bicycle scene. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## wheel-drive-callout

### Wheel rotation · leather trimmer callout

Stable ID: `wheel-drive-callout`

Wheel rotation · leather trimmer callout. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## layered-walking-feet

### Layered walking feet · shoe handoff

Stable ID: `layered-walking-feet`

Layered walking feet · shoe handoff. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## shoe-evolution-route

### Shoe evolution · dashed route and nodes

Stable ID: `shoe-evolution-route`

Shoe evolution · dashed route and nodes. Independent media bindings, parameters and shared playback controls. V59: established boy-room cutouts, explicit vase overlap, linked phase clock, depth-layered rubble, close wheel, attached trouser/shoe sources and four independent route sources. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## model-scene-studio

### Build a 3D scene from scratch

Stable ID: `model-scene-studio`

Local primitives, groups, camera, lights and keyframes; editable assemblies; OBJ geometry and scene JSON import/export.

#### Implementation

- [model-studio.js](../../dist/model-studio.js) — SHA-256 `02189b3e3efb9578f0591cd5dee84e0a99735727f01741a42d5fa7dc5c6306ef`; functions: `transformVertex` (line 6), `sampleModelTrack` (line 7), `modelNodeAt` (line 8), `modelGeometry` (line 9), `validateModelScene` (line 18), `modelSceneMeshes` (line 19), `walk` (line 19), `textureData` (line 20), `paintModelScene` (line 21), `importModelOBJ` (line 22), `exportModelOBJ` (line 23), `projectModelPoint` (line 26).
- [model-recipes.js](../../dist/model-recipes.js) — SHA-256 `17ef47a356fedb4aef3c652b519ad00a48a7a1292f25d251c73568551bd2c294`; functions: `modelPart` (line 1), `modelBeam` (line 2), `helmetModel` (line 3), `bicycleModel` (line 4), `bipedModel` (line 5), `ruinModel` (line 6), `createModelRecipe` (line 7), `createRuinedStreet` (line 8).
- [model-webgl.js](../../dist/model-webgl.js) — SHA-256 `edb1feb06a4ed7b406c9fc5654bb16ac2bdd2d14f57a1d320685c9dc32a207d3`; functions: `createModelGPU` (line 2).
- [model-studio-director.js](../../dist/model-studio-director.js) — SHA-256 `33b8fab4f658dec98655f230fb6fd51491e77078731847ab73cc2bddf48d9662`; functions: `editor` (line 1), `remove` (line 1).

#### Controls and compatibility

    "parameters": "Independent per-instance copies; nested JSON editable",

    "direction": "Timing reversal; geometric axes only where implemented",
    "geometry": "Images remain planes; full unseen object reconstruction is not implemented."

#### Exact factory values

| Parameter | Exact default | Type | Unit / meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scene3D` | See JSON below | object | Native renderer units; inspect linked implementation before conversion | `model-studio.js#modelStudioDefaults` |

#### Limitations

- Convex extrusion caps; no booleans/sculpting/automatic semantic model generation.
- OBJ import is geometry only; no MTL, glTF or 3DS parser.
- Human rig is a blockout; photo puppet needs calibration.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## moving-magnifier

### Moving magnifier over media

Stable ID: `moving-magnifier`

A moving circular lens samples a synchronized enlarged region of the same source; rim and handle remain independent. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Stylized magnification, not a physically simulated optical lens.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## paper-unfurl-reveal

### Unfurl a printed picture

Stable ID: `paper-unfurl-reveal`

A gray reverse-face sheet opens over paper and reveals a replaceable picture. V61: photographic classic walker with both arms; asymmetric ruins, broad explosion/smoke and timed electrical collapse with sparks. V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Implementation

#### Limitations

- Authored mesh; not physical cloth/paper simulation.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## rigged-cutout-walk

### Classic cutout walk · preserved V59

Stable ID: `rigged-cutout-walk`

Original photographic cutout walker with its original static arms. Original artwork, legs and archived V60 engine retained; V61 both-arm animation is a separate searchable variant.

#### Implementation

- [cutout-walk.js](../../dist/cutout-walk.js) — SHA-256 `dcb1fca9e74bce970059d1ca73947d0260bf6d8c0c1a4ac1a78b31894afbaf76`; functions: `parts` (line 3), `cutoutWalkPose` (line 4), `deformWalkArm` (line 5), `paintArmMesh` (line 6), `paintCutoutWalk` (line 7).

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## classic-walk-with-hands

### Photographic walk · both arms and hands

Stable ID: `classic-walk-with-hands`

Original classic photographic artwork with shoulder, elbow and wrist movement on both arms; torch follows the hand. Pace, amplitudes and attachment points editable. Artwork-specific polygon calibration and a clone-texture undercoat patch, not automatic rigging.

#### Implementation

- [cutout-walk.js](../../dist/cutout-walk.js) — SHA-256 `dcb1fca9e74bce970059d1ca73947d0260bf6d8c0c1a4ac1a78b31894afbaf76`; functions: `parts` (line 3), `cutoutWalkPose` (line 4), `deformWalkArm` (line 5), `paintArmMesh` (line 6), `paintCutoutWalk` (line 7).

## layered-room-color-reveal

### Paper photo · colored room and person reveal

Stable ID: `layered-room-color-reveal`

Separate paper surround, colored room/window, shelf, monochrome mother, incoming boy, sill cloth and foreground basin. Independent media replacement, appearance clocks and depth response; simple shared Quick edit controls. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

#### Limitations

- Reference-informed reconstruction; original production geometry and exact camera are unproven.
- Image puppet is calibrated to its default source, not automatic human retargeting.
- Partial final transition has no invented destination.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## grounded-photographic-walk

### Photographic walk · ground-constrained soles

Stable ID: `grounded-photographic-walk`

Original photographic articulated walker with vertical modeled-sole correction. Source identity and arm/torch transforms retained. Horizontal stance locking and terrain collision are not implemented.

#### Implementation

- [cutout-walk.js](../../dist/cutout-walk.js) — SHA-256 `dcb1fca9e74bce970059d1ca73947d0260bf6d8c0c1a4ac1a78b31894afbaf76`; functions: `parts` (line 3), `cutoutWalkPose` (line 4), `deformWalkArm` (line 5), `paintArmMesh` (line 6), `paintCutoutWalk` (line 7).
- [grounded-walk.js](../../dist/grounded-walk.js) — SHA-256 `4f668f9bb385236342bdda69c2dd2dc7132751a3eb2957271c9959f523a08e5f`; functions: `groundedWalkState` (line 4), `sourceFootHulls` (line 5), `paintGroundedWalk` (line 6).

#### Limitations

- Illustrative reconstruction; missing bridge now has separate V67 commerce actions. Current chapter ends mid-pose; no full anatomical or 3D recovery.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Illustrative reconstruction; missing bridge now has separate V67 commerce actions. Current chapter ends mid-pose; no full anatomical or 3D recovery.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## opposed-rivalry-reveal

### Opposing rivalry heads

Stable ID: `opposed-rivalry-reveal`

Foreshortened colored panels reveal inward-facing metallic heads, logos and parented eye fire.

#### Implementation

- [chapter-sequence.js](../../dist/chapter-sequence.js) — SHA-256 `25bba8853f5d67e4e47f901bdc5659fee274331258fb0f48b48a349425264e1a`; functions: `chapterSequenceState` (line 63), `restoreChapterImage` (line 64), `resolveChapterMedia` (line 65), `chapterCutout` (line 67), `chapterLayerRect` (line 74), `sprite` (line 75), `imageLayer` (line 79), `vignette` (line 80), `black` (line 81), `editedSurface` (line 82), `sky` (line 83), `ground` (line 84), `skyRaw` (line 85), `groundRaw` (line 86), `roleWord` (line 99), `roomBack` (line 101), `room` (line 102), `transformFactoryRect` (line 124), `factory` (line 125), `fireMedia` (line 135), `chapterEyePoint` (line 136), `eyeFire` (line 137), `rivalry` (line 138), `glyph` (line 148), `chapterTitle` (line 149), `personAt` (line 156), `sports` (line 157), `growthTableau` (line 165), `growth` (line 171), `chapterOcclusionEdge` (line 172), `clipSide` (line 173), `treePass` (line 174), `poseHandoff` (line 175), `paintChapterSequence` (line 176), `paintChapterWindowJoin` (line 180), `paintChapterRoomLeadIn` (line 183).

## scatter-chapter-title

## team-depth-introduction

### Team and salesman introduction

Stable ID: `team-depth-introduction`

Twelve independent athlete sprites recede; standing bag-carrying salesman rises from foreground.

#### Implementation

- [chapter-sequence.js](../../dist/chapter-sequence.js) — SHA-256 `25bba8853f5d67e4e47f901bdc5659fee274331258fb0f48b48a349425264e1a`; functions: `chapterSequenceState` (line 63), `restoreChapterImage` (line 64), `resolveChapterMedia` (line 65), `chapterCutout` (line 67), `chapterLayerRect` (line 74), `sprite` (line 75), `imageLayer` (line 79), `vignette` (line 80), `black` (line 81), `editedSurface` (line 82), `sky` (line 83), `ground` (line 84), `skyRaw` (line 85), `groundRaw` (line 86), `roleWord` (line 99), `roomBack` (line 101), `room` (line 102), `transformFactoryRect` (line 124), `factory` (line 125), `fireMedia` (line 135), `chapterEyePoint` (line 136), `eyeFire` (line 137), `rivalry` (line 138), `glyph` (line 148), `chapterTitle` (line 149), `personAt` (line 156), `sports` (line 157), `growthTableau` (line 165), `growth` (line 171), `chapterOcclusionEdge` (line 172), `clipSide` (line 173), `treePass` (line 174), `poseHandoff` (line 175), `paintChapterSequence` (line 176), `paintChapterWindowJoin` (line 180), `paintChapterRoomLeadIn` (line 183).

#### Limitations

- Illustrative reconstruction; missing bridge now has separate V67 commerce actions. Current chapter ends mid-pose; no full anatomical or 3D recovery.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## tree-occlusion-pass

### Tree scene boundary

Stable ID: `tree-occlusion-pass`

#### Limitations

- Illustrative reconstruction; missing bridge now has separate V67 commerce actions. Current chapter ends mid-pose; no full anatomical or 3D recovery.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Illustrative reconstruction; missing bridge now has separate V67 commerce actions. Current chapter ends mid-pose; no full anatomical or 3D recovery.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## factory-pose-handoff

### Factory pose handoff

Stable ID: `factory-pose-handoff`

Lateral old-tableau exit with incoming arms-open poses and another factory; ends mid-motion.

#### Implementation

- [chapter-sequence.js](../../dist/chapter-sequence.js) — SHA-256 `25bba8853f5d67e4e47f901bdc5659fee274331258fb0f48b48a349425264e1a`; functions: `chapterSequenceState` (line 63), `restoreChapterImage` (line 64), `resolveChapterMedia` (line 65), `chapterCutout` (line 67), `chapterLayerRect` (line 74), `sprite` (line 75), `imageLayer` (line 79), `vignette` (line 80), `black` (line 81), `editedSurface` (line 82), `sky` (line 83), `ground` (line 84), `skyRaw` (line 85), `groundRaw` (line 86), `roleWord` (line 99), `roomBack` (line 101), `room` (line 102), `transformFactoryRect` (line 124), `factory` (line 125), `fireMedia` (line 135), `chapterEyePoint` (line 136), `eyeFire` (line 137), `rivalry` (line 138), `glyph` (line 148), `chapterTitle` (line 149), `personAt` (line 156), `sports` (line 157), `growthTableau` (line 165), `growth` (line 171), `chapterOcclusionEdge` (line 172), `clipSide` (line 173), `treePass` (line 174), `poseHandoff` (line 175), `paintChapterSequence` (line 176), `paintChapterWindowJoin` (line 180), `paintChapterRoomLeadIn` (line 183).

#### Limitations

- Illustrative reconstruction; missing bridge now has separate V67 commerce actions. Current chapter ends mid-pose; no full anatomical or 3D recovery.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## commerce-room-bridge

### Money, street exchange and room entrance

Stable ID: `commerce-room-bridge`

Money, street exchange and room entrance with separately editable sources, deterministic timing and depth layers.

#### Limitations

- Generated illustrative artwork; not original footage or recovered 3D. Approximate trajectories and camera. User visual acceptance pending. Integrated template timing uses stage durations; standalone duration uses bridgeDuration.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## commerce-street-exchange

### Street exchange through foreground shoulder

Stable ID: `commerce-street-exchange`

Street exchange through foreground shoulder with separately editable sources, deterministic timing and depth layers.

#### Limitations

- Generated illustrative artwork; not original footage or recovered 3D. Approximate trajectories and camera. User visual acceptance pending. Integrated template timing uses stage durations; standalone duration uses bridgeDuration.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## commerce-cash-burst

### Depth-ordered tumbling money

Stable ID: `commerce-cash-burst`

| `globeRadiusKeys` | See JSON below | array | [native curve seconds, projected radius in stage pixels] pairs | `globe-opening.js#globeDefaults` |

#### Limitations

- Authored curves calibrated to reference samples, not recovered production curves.
- NASA 2004 surface and 2016 night data are modern geographic textures, not historical imagery.
- Procedural perspective sphere with texture projection; no recovered physical globe or original camera.
- After the cloud wipe the independent action uses the existing illustrative aerial map; the main template reveals its preserved map scene.
- CPU pixel renderer may reduce playback speed on slower devices; use Render Scale to trade preview sampling for speed.
- V70 is an authored dramatic interpretation using supplied narration cues, not a claim of exact reference reconstruction.
- Main-template sound is opt-in after a user gesture; independent composition actions remain visual and sound stems must be mixed separately.
- Review narration/audio comes from the supplied reference; synthesized sound master/stems contain no voice or third-party samples.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Native editor tools; no independent retiming of arbitrary layers. Story anchors are authored estimates, not voice alignment recovered from audio.
- Classic photographic cutout uses bounded image-space stance correction; not a complete no-slip world-space walk solve.
- Town ellipse is an illustrative callout, not a surveyed border.
- Attached narration is stored locally. No reference voice or new ending is bundled.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

- Historical archive photographs differ from reference photographs. Generated people, rooms and field are illustrative reconstructions.
- Review preview is silent; no new narration, score or sound mix was created.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Native canvas stage 960×540. Photographic 2.5D planes; no recovered full-body running cycle or volumetric architecture.
- Owens poses, supporting people, sculpture and environments are illustrative reconstructions. Exact likeness and pose differ from source.
- Historical portrait remains a rectangular archival photograph following an image-tool background-removal refusal; isolated source portrait is not reproduced.
- TV screen uses a rounded clip, scanlines, tint/reflection and camera projection; no ray-traced convex glass reconstruction.
- Preview is silent; no new narration or sound mix. The meeting setup ends before shoe presentation.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.
- Changing credited filmed flame frames; generated-keyframe optical-flow blast, not fluid physics.
- Sampled reference timing; preview audio is user-supplied.
- Aircraft turns are2.5D bank/yaw projection of one photograph; no unseen model geometry. Propeller is hub-attached procedural shutter-sampled blades.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.

- Sampled reference timing; preview audio is user-supplied.

- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.
- Changing credited filmed flame frames; generated-keyframe optical-flow blast, not fluid physics.
- Sampled reference timing; preview audio is user-supplied.
- Aircraft turns are2.5D bank/yaw projection of one photograph; no unseen model geometry. Propeller is hub-attached procedural shutter-sampled blades.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.

- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.

- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.
- Changing credited filmed flame frames; generated-keyframe optical-flow blast, not fluid physics.
- Sampled reference timing; preview audio is user-supplied.
- Aircraft turns are2.5D bank/yaw projection of one photograph; no unseen model geometry. Propeller is hub-attached procedural shutter-sampled blades.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.
- Changing credited filmed flame frames; generated-keyframe optical-flow blast, not fluid physics.
- Sampled reference timing; preview audio is user-supplied.

- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.
- Changing credited filmed flame frames; generated-keyframe optical-flow blast, not fluid physics.
- Sampled reference timing; preview audio is user-supplied.
- Aircraft turns are2.5D bank/yaw projection of one photograph; no unseen model geometry. Propeller is hub-attached procedural shutter-sampled blades.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.
- Changing credited filmed flame frames; generated-keyframe optical-flow blast, not fluid physics.
- Sampled reference timing; preview audio is user-supplied.
- Aircraft turns are2.5D bank/yaw projection of one photograph; no unseen model geometry. Propeller is hub-attached procedural shutter-sampled blades.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.
- Changing credited filmed flame frames; generated-keyframe optical-flow blast, not fluid physics.
- Sampled reference timing; preview audio is user-supplied.
- Aircraft turns are2.5D bank/yaw projection of one photograph; no unseen model geometry. Propeller is hub-attached procedural shutter-sampled blades.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.

- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.
- Changing credited filmed flame frames; generated-keyframe optical-flow blast, not fluid physics.
- Sampled reference timing; preview audio is user-supplied.
- Aircraft turns are2.5D bank/yaw projection of one photograph; no unseen model geometry. Propeller is hub-attached procedural shutter-sampled blades.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Generated fictional people and buildings, not archival evidence or exact likenesses.
- Foreground portraits are held photographic planes. Crowd uses authored 2D two-link walking rigs, not recovered performances or 3D.

- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## checkpoint-seated-coach-drift

## checkpoint-blue-pair-cut

## native3d-humanoid

### Anatomical humanoid study

Stable ID: `native3d-humanoid`

Editable specialized native 3D workshop: male/female body foundation, regional shape, mirrored vertex brushes, four-influence skin weights, driven correctives, garment clearance, hat centering, joint limits, saved poses, contacts, attachments and physical finishes. Bundled locally inside Blank Composition.

#### Limitations

- Specialized character and prop surface tools; no general topology editor or cloth simulator.
- Body targets and garment transfer do not establish finished anatomy, tailored clothing or collision-free fitting.
- Brush picking is triangle based and radius uses bind space. Weight assignment is per vertex, not a brush stroke.
- Correctives use local Euler drivers; extreme shapes and combinations require visual review.
- Native JSON preserves all workshop data. GLB exports evaluated mesh and sampled transforms; changing procedural materials or driven geometry may differ externally.
- Source footage remains an illustrative approximation, not an exact match.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## native3d-crimson

### Crimson seated character scene

Stable ID: `native3d-crimson`

Editable specialized native 3D workshop: male/female body foundation, regional shape, mirrored vertex brushes, four-influence skin weights, driven correctives, garment clearance, hat centering, joint limits, saved poses, contacts, attachments and physical finishes. Bundled locally inside Blank Composition.

    "geometry": "Images remain planes; full unseen object reconstruction is not implemented."
  },

#### Exact factory values

| Parameter | Exact default | Type | Unit / meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `native3DScene` | See JSON below | object | Serializable3D scene: positions meters, rotations degrees, key times seconds; materials0–1 | `native3d-director.js#nativeCrimsonDefaults` |

#### Limitations

- Specialized character and prop surface tools; no general topology editor or cloth simulator.
- Body targets and garment transfer do not establish finished anatomy, tailored clothing or collision-free fitting.
- Brush picking is triangle based and radius uses bind space. Weight assignment is per vertex, not a brush stroke.
- Correctives use local Euler drivers; extreme shapes and combinations require visual review.
- Native JSON preserves all workshop data. GLB exports evaluated mesh and sampled transforms; changing procedural materials or driven geometry may differ externally.
- Source footage remains an illustrative approximation, not an exact match.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Exact factory values

|---|---|---|---|---|

#### Limitations

- Specialized character and prop surface tools; no general topology editor or cloth simulator.
- Body targets and garment transfer do not establish finished anatomy, tailored clothing or collision-free fitting.
- Brush picking is triangle based and radius uses bind space. Weight assignment is per vertex, not a brush stroke.
- Correctives use local Euler drivers; extreme shapes and combinations require visual review.
- Native JSON preserves all workshop data. GLB exports evaluated mesh and sampled transforms; changing procedural materials or driven geometry may differ externally.
- Source footage remains an illustrative approximation, not an exact match.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## native3d-checkpoint

### Native anatomical scene ·14:55–15:00

Stable ID: `native3d-checkpoint`

Editable specialized native 3D workshop: male/female body foundation, regional shape, mirrored vertex brushes, four-influence skin weights, driven correctives, garment clearance, hat centering, joint limits, saved poses, contacts, attachments and physical finishes. Bundled locally inside Blank Composition.

## native3d-female

### Female anatomical foundation

Stable ID: `native3d-female`

Editable specialized native 3D workshop: male/female body foundation, regional shape, mirrored vertex brushes, four-influence skin weights, driven correctives, garment clearance, hat centering, joint limits, saved poses, contacts, attachments and physical finishes. Bundled locally inside Blank Composition.

#### Implementation

#### Exact factory values

| Parameter | Exact default | Type | Unit / meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `native3DScene` | See JSON below | object | Serializable3D scene: positions meters, rotations degrees, key times seconds; materials0–1 | `native3d-director.js#nativeFemaleDefaults` |

#### Limitations

- Specialized character and prop surface tools; no general topology editor or cloth simulator.
- Body targets and garment transfer do not establish finished anatomy, tailored clothing or collision-free fitting.
- Brush picking is triangle based and radius uses bind space. Weight assignment is per vertex, not a brush stroke.
- Correctives use local Euler drivers; extreme shapes and combinations require visual review.
- Native JSON preserves all workshop data. GLB exports evaluated mesh and sampled transforms; changing procedural materials or driven geometry may differ externally.
- Source footage remains an illustrative approximation, not an exact match.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## history-stage-eye-portal

### eye portal

Stable ID: `history-stage-eye-portal`

Reusable eye portal stage. Native source timeline and dependencies retained.

#### Implementation

- [history-motion.js](../../dist/history-motion.js) — SHA-256 `7569a7ef586d43ebdbd97e75758a7da2a5393adca6f774036904d0f744a2b15a`; functions: `migrateExpansionShots` (line 7), `historyState` (line 10), `migrateCommerceBridgeShots` (line 12).
- [history-scene.js](../../dist/history-scene.js) — SHA-256 `1ffbb2a0116c5197151463fea8a39915a4493706648eb93e171234ee891a1d41`; functions: `createHistoryScene` (line 17), `plate` (line 19), `workshop` (line 20), `portrait` (line 21), `shoulder` (line 22), `ruins` (line 23), `silhouette` (line 24), `paper` (line 25), `strip` (line 26), `reel` (line 27), `card` (line 28).
- [history-director.js](../../dist/history-director.js) — SHA-256 `c18bc7289895c1df0949d826ab52681bf6eaa48a0ab63d10709ebbf985838f50`; functions: inline/class renderer.
- [history-footage.js](../../dist/history-footage.js) — SHA-256 `44919c74177cc1cdd1305ff84378ecb11df553e36832254ec9ee74a670a45dab`; functions: `aftermathSettings` (line 8), `paintAftermath` (line 10).
- [portrait-room.js](../../dist/portrait-room.js) — SHA-256 `baa8a92c2c61ecfe85624b2304baa448c8e26b275041571d1a1907ac190ae300`; functions: `portraitRoomState` (line 7), `projectRoomPoint` (line 8), `portraitRoomGeometry` (line 10), `triangle` (line 11), `bilerp` (line 12), `surface` (line 13), `spriteRect` (line 14), `paintPortraitRoom` (line 16), `layer` (line 16).

- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## history-stage-over-shoulder

### over shoulder

Stable ID: `history-stage-over-shoulder`

Reusable over shoulder stage. Native source timeline and dependencies retained.

#### Implementation

- [history-motion.js](../../dist/history-motion.js) — SHA-256 `7569a7ef586d43ebdbd97e75758a7da2a5393adca6f774036904d0f744a2b15a`; functions: `migrateExpansionShots` (line 7), `historyState` (line 10), `migrateCommerceBridgeShots` (line 12).
- [history-scene.js](../../dist/history-scene.js) — SHA-256 `1ffbb2a0116c5197151463fea8a39915a4493706648eb93e171234ee891a1d41`; functions: `createHistoryScene` (line 17), `plate` (line 19), `workshop` (line 20), `portrait` (line 21), `shoulder` (line 22), `ruins` (line 23), `silhouette` (line 24), `paper` (line 25), `strip` (line 26), `reel` (line 27), `card` (line 28).
- [history-director.js](../../dist/history-director.js) — SHA-256 `c18bc7289895c1df0949d826ab52681bf6eaa48a0ab63d10709ebbf985838f50`; functions: inline/class renderer.
- [history-footage.js](../../dist/history-footage.js) — SHA-256 `44919c74177cc1cdd1305ff84378ecb11df553e36832254ec9ee74a670a45dab`; functions: `aftermathSettings` (line 8), `paintAftermath` (line 10).
- [portrait-room.js](../../dist/portrait-room.js) — SHA-256 `baa8a92c2c61ecfe85624b2304baa448c8e26b275041571d1a1907ac190ae300`; functions: `portraitRoomState` (line 7), `projectRoomPoint` (line 8), `portraitRoomGeometry` (line 10), `triangle` (line 11), `bilerp` (line 12), `surface` (line 13), `spriteRect` (line 14), `paintPortraitRoom` (line 16), `layer` (line 16).

## history-stage-shoe-turn

### shoe turn

Stable ID: `history-stage-shoe-turn`

Reusable shoe turn stage. Native source timeline and dependencies retained.

#### Implementation

- [history-motion.js](../../dist/history-motion.js) — SHA-256 `7569a7ef586d43ebdbd97e75758a7da2a5393adca6f774036904d0f744a2b15a`; functions: `migrateExpansionShots` (line 7), `historyState` (line 10), `migrateCommerceBridgeShots` (line 12).
- [history-scene.js](../../dist/history-scene.js) — SHA-256 `1ffbb2a0116c5197151463fea8a39915a4493706648eb93e171234ee891a1d41`; functions: `createHistoryScene` (line 17), `plate` (line 19), `workshop` (line 20), `portrait` (line 21), `shoulder` (line 22), `ruins` (line 23), `silhouette` (line 24), `paper` (line 25), `strip` (line 26), `reel` (line 27), `card` (line 28).

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## history-stage-ruined-street

### ruined street

Stable ID: `history-stage-ruined-street`

Reusable ruined street stage. Native source timeline and dependencies retained.

#### Implementation

- [history-motion.js](../../dist/history-motion.js) — SHA-256 `7569a7ef586d43ebdbd97e75758a7da2a5393adca6f774036904d0f744a2b15a`; functions: `migrateExpansionShots` (line 7), `historyState` (line 10), `migrateCommerceBridgeShots` (line 12).
- [history-scene.js](../../dist/history-scene.js) — SHA-256 `1ffbb2a0116c5197151463fea8a39915a4493706648eb93e171234ee891a1d41`; functions: `createHistoryScene` (line 17), `plate` (line 19), `workshop` (line 20), `portrait` (line 21), `shoulder` (line 22), `ruins` (line 23), `silhouette` (line 24), `paper` (line 25), `strip` (line 26), `reel` (line 27), `card` (line 28).
- [history-director.js](../../dist/history-director.js) — SHA-256 `c18bc7289895c1df0949d826ab52681bf6eaa48a0ab63d10709ebbf985838f50`; functions: inline/class renderer.
- [history-footage.js](../../dist/history-footage.js) — SHA-256 `44919c74177cc1cdd1305ff84378ecb11df553e36832254ec9ee74a670a45dab`; functions: `aftermathSettings` (line 8), `paintAftermath` (line 10).
- [portrait-room.js](../../dist/portrait-room.js) — SHA-256 `baa8a92c2c61ecfe85624b2304baa448c8e26b275041571d1a1907ac190ae300`; functions: `portraitRoomState` (line 7), `projectRoomPoint` (line 8), `portraitRoomGeometry` (line 10), `triangle` (line 11), `bilerp` (line 12), `surface` (line 13), `spriteRect` (line 14), `paintPortraitRoom` (line 16), `layer` (line 16).

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## history-stage-vertical-workshop-passage

### vertical workshop passage

Stable ID: `history-stage-vertical-workshop-passage`

Reusable vertical workshop passage stage. Native source timeline and dependencies retained.

#### Implementation

- [history-motion.js](../../dist/history-motion.js) — SHA-256 `7569a7ef586d43ebdbd97e75758a7da2a5393adca6f774036904d0f744a2b15a`; functions: `migrateExpansionShots` (line 7), `historyState` (line 10), `migrateCommerceBridgeShots` (line 12).
- [history-scene.js](../../dist/history-scene.js) — SHA-256 `1ffbb2a0116c5197151463fea8a39915a4493706648eb93e171234ee891a1d41`; functions: `createHistoryScene` (line 17), `plate` (line 19), `workshop` (line 20), `portrait` (line 21), `shoulder` (line 22), `ruins` (line 23), `silhouette` (line 24), `paper` (line 25), `strip` (line 26), `reel` (line 27), `card` (line 28).

## history-stage-wheel-trimmer

### wheel trimmer

Stable ID: `history-stage-wheel-trimmer`

Reusable wheel trimmer stage. Native source timeline and dependencies retained.

#### Implementation

- [history-motion.js](../../dist/history-motion.js) — SHA-256 `7569a7ef586d43ebdbd97e75758a7da2a5393adca6f774036904d0f744a2b15a`; functions: `migrateExpansionShots` (line 7), `historyState` (line 10), `migrateCommerceBridgeShots` (line 12).
- [history-scene.js](../../dist/history-scene.js) — SHA-256 `1ffbb2a0116c5197151463fea8a39915a4493706648eb93e171234ee891a1d41`; functions: `createHistoryScene` (line 17), `plate` (line 19), `workshop` (line 20), `portrait` (line 21), `shoulder` (line 22), `ruins` (line 23), `silhouette` (line 24), `paper` (line 25), `strip` (line 26), `reel` (line 27), `card` (line 28).
- [history-director.js](../../dist/history-director.js) — SHA-256 `c18bc7289895c1df0949d826ab52681bf6eaa48a0ab63d10709ebbf985838f50`; functions: inline/class renderer.
- [history-footage.js](../../dist/history-footage.js) — SHA-256 `44919c74177cc1cdd1305ff84378ecb11df553e36832254ec9ee74a670a45dab`; functions: `aftermathSettings` (line 8), `paintAftermath` (line 10).
- [portrait-room.js](../../dist/portrait-room.js) — SHA-256 `baa8a92c2c61ecfe85624b2304baa448c8e26b275041571d1a1907ac190ae300`; functions: `portraitRoomState` (line 7), `projectRoomPoint` (line 8), `portraitRoomGeometry` (line 10), `triangle` (line 11), `bilerp` (line 12), `surface` (line 13), `spriteRect` (line 14), `paintPortraitRoom` (line 16), `layer` (line 16).

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

#### Limitations

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## history-stage-chapter-factory-pullback

### chapter factory pullback

Stable ID: `history-stage-chapter-factory-pullback`

Reusable chapter factory pullback stage. Native source timeline and dependencies retained.

#### Implementation

- [history-motion.js](../../dist/history-motion.js) — SHA-256 `7569a7ef586d43ebdbd97e75758a7da2a5393adca6f774036904d0f744a2b15a`; functions: `migrateExpansionShots` (line 7), `historyState` (line 10), `migrateCommerceBridgeShots` (line 12).
- [history-scene.js](../../dist/history-scene.js) — SHA-256 `1ffbb2a0116c5197151463fea8a39915a4493706648eb93e171234ee891a1d41`; functions: `createHistoryScene` (line 17), `plate` (line 19), `workshop` (line 20), `portrait` (line 21), `shoulder` (line 22), `ruins` (line 23), `silhouette` (line 24), `paper` (line 25), `strip` (line 26), `reel` (line 27), `card` (line 28).
- [history-director.js](../../dist/history-director.js) — SHA-256 `c18bc7289895c1df0949d826ab52681bf6eaa48a0ab63d10709ebbf985838f50`; functions: inline/class renderer.
- [history-footage.js](../../dist/history-footage.js) — SHA-256 `44919c74177cc1cdd1305ff84378ecb11df553e36832254ec9ee74a670a45dab`; functions: `aftermathSettings` (line 8), `paintAftermath` (line 10).
- [portrait-room.js](../../dist/portrait-room.js) — SHA-256 `baa8a92c2c61ecfe85624b2304baa448c8e26b275041571d1a1907ac190ae300`; functions: `portraitRoomState` (line 7), `projectRoomPoint` (line 8), `portraitRoomGeometry` (line 10), `triangle` (line 11), `bilerp` (line 12), `surface` (line 13), `spriteRect` (line 14), `paintPortraitRoom` (line 16), `layer` (line 16).

- Native scene and media dependencies remain applicable.
- Native units must not be reinterpreted without inspecting the linked renderer.
- Image planes do not reconstruct unseen geometry. Artwork-specific gesture rigs require native calibration.

## history-stage-chapter-pose-handoff

### chapter pose handoff

Stable ID: `history-stage-chapter-pose-handoff`

Reusable chapter pose handoff stage. Native source timeline and dependencies retained.

#### Implementation

- [history-motion.js](../../dist/history-motion.js) — SHA-256 `7569a7ef586d43ebdbd97e75758a7da2a5393adca6f774036904d0f744a2b15a`; functions: `migrateExpansionShots` (line 7), `historyState` (line 10), `migrateCommerceBridgeShots` (line 12).
- [history-scene.js](../../dist/history-scene.js) — SHA-256 `1ffbb2a0116c5197151463fea8a39915a4493706648eb93e171234ee891a1d41`; functions: `createHistoryScene` (line 17), `plate` (line 19), `workshop` (line 20), `portrait` (line 21), `shoulder` (line 22), `ruins` (line 23), `silhouette` (line 24), `paper` (line 25), `strip` (line 26), `reel` (line 27), `card` (line 28).
- [history-director.js](../../dist/history-director.js) — SHA-256 `c18bc7289895c1df0949d826ab52681bf6eaa48a0ab63d10709ebbf985838f50`; functions: inline/class renderer.
- [history-footage.js](../../dist/history-footage.js) — SHA-256 `44919c74177cc1cdd1305ff84378ecb11df553e36832254ec9ee74a670a45dab`; functions: `aftermathSettings` (line 8), `paintAftermath` (line 10).
- [portrait-room.js](../../dist/portrait-room.js) — SHA-256 `baa8a92c2c61ecfe85624b2304baa448c8e26b275041571d1a1907ac190ae300`; functions: `portraitRoomState` (line 7), `projectRoomPoint` (line 8), `portraitRoomGeometry` (line 10), `triangle` (line 11), `bilerp` (line 12), `surface` (line 13), `spriteRect` (line 14), `paintPortraitRoom` (line 16), `layer` (line 16).
